comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a robot-gripper opening stop; PR-125 aligns mating flanges and inserts locating pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires concentric threaded-tool counterholding; PR-125 requires holding flange faces and holes aligned while inserting horizontal pins.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate succeeds on a locked 90° setting retained through three cycles; PR-125 succeeds on flange-axis alignment and correctly seated pins.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual assembly, but flange alignment and pin insertion do not test preserving a threaded adjustment during jam-nut locking; no rubric details are missing.
